                                             Greek.fi Options Protocol

                                                     Mahmoud Lababidi
                                                         ml@greek.fi
                                                    (Dated: June 26, 2025)
               Greek.fi is a protocol that enables decentralized American-style exercisable (American) options
             that are fully collateralized. It is designed for composability, exercisability, and universal use on
             any EVM-compatible chain and allows any ERC20 token to be used as collateral and consideration,
             including wBTC, wETH, stETH, USDC, and USDT.
               This new level of composability enables new options ecosystem that allows and goes beyond tra-
             ditional financial options strategies. Greek achieves capital eﬀiciency through decentralized lending.
